title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Some burdenbeasts won't drag themselves to work until they're whipped. But you're different, Doctor, you're way smarter than a beast, isn't that true?

title: Talk 1
original: Doctor. Just to put any little misunderstandings to rest, let me say this now. Maria might call me her aunt, but that's only because I'm higher in the family. I'm still young. I'm not much older than her. And, I'm still not married. Clear?

title: Talk 2
original: A spat between me and Dobermann...? Oh, don't worry, she's a top-of-the-top instructor, I know that. We've just had a bit of a… bit of a difference on how we like to train our people, that's all.

title: Talk 3
original: There's plenty at Rhodes Island who pack personality AND strength. You could pick anyone, turn them into competition knights, and have every eye in the room on them... Well, maybe let's not stir that pot.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Doctor, can I borrow you? I just want you to help me carry some things. What things, you ask? Well... Hmm... all sorts of random things I buy when the mood strikes me.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: My injury...? Well, I'm not setting foot in that arena ever again, and I've long since learned to get along with my right hand. So let's not worry yourself, okay? Or maybe... you're just being polite, Doctor? Tiptoeing around saying I can't fight at operator standards, huh?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: My little Maria, she just runs away to the Engineering Department any time she's free. Such a headstrong girl she is, I never know what to say. Where did I go wrong that she ended up like this...? Well, whatever. Compared to forcing herself to arm up and do what she doesn't want to, life is better this way.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Hm…? Oh, Hello, Doctor. No, I've just been feeling a little empty. Margaret never needs my fussing, Maria's found what she wants to do here, but... what about me...? Oh, gosh, what am I saying? Don't you worry about me, Doctor. I'm fine.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Doctor, we don't get along half bad, but you don't just lie there and leave it all up to me, not in your wildest dreams. I hate danger plenty, but layabouts leave a bad taste in my mouth. Though, when your back's against the wall... Well, we can talk about it then!

title: Idle
original: Someone's easygoing, eh? Alright then, I'll let you nap for ten minutes.

title: Onboard
original: Ahh, this is Rhodes Island, is it? I'm Whislash Zofia. As a former competition knight of Kazimierz, trust me when I say I'll whip your operators into shape.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: I've never even heard of fighting like this before!

title: Promotion 1
original: So this is a Rhodes Island promotion, then...? Good. I don't pay much attention to my wages, but getting paid for my effort feels nice. Thank you.

title: Promotion 2
original: Hmm, thinking about it carefully, the pay here is not bad, life is good enough, and I get to see Maria and Margaret all the time. Staying here as an instructor sounds like a great choice.

title: Added to Squad
original: Let's see who you've got on this one.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Alright, I'll lead the team.

title: Depart
original: Get ready, everyone! We're moving out!

title: Begin Operation
original: You all know your job? Alright.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: My time to shine.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: About time, Doctor.

title: Deployment 1
original: Assess the situation first.

title: Deployment 2
original: Whislash Zofia, attacking!

title: In Battle 1
original: Do not underestimate me!

title: In Battle 2
original: Perfect chance!

title: In Battle 3
original: You won't be able to withstand the whip!

title: In Battle 4
original: You're finished!

title: 4-star Result
original: Honestly, I was going to have a word with you about taking such a dangerous mission, but since you tied things up so beautifully, I'll just let it slide…

title: 3-star Result
original: I can tell you're a perfectionist... Well, nothing wrong with that.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: We won, and that's enough, no? Let's not obsess over it.

title: Operation Failure
original: Doctor, don't just stand there! Follow me!

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Well, this interior's got taste!

title: Tap
original: What?!

title: Trust Tap
original: Doctor, you've got to focus on your work.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Since Margaret left Kazimierz, we haven't had a chance to spend New Year's together. So, I'll have to go all-out for today's banquet… Oh, Doctor, would you like to join the Nearl family feast? You're cordially invited.

title: Greeting
original: How do you do, Doctor?

title: Birthday
original: Happy birthday, Doctor. I got you a little gift. Sign right here. It's not a big plot, but I picked the location with care. The scenery is gorgeous. You could build a villa, or garden or something… What? Why are you looking at me like that? Is land not an appropriate birthday present for a friend?

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: I've met all sorts of fascinating little guys at Rhodes Island. The light in their eyes when they train is the same as I see in Maria's. I'm eager to see them transform into capable fighters. And until that day, I'll keep whipping them into shape. Oh, make no mistake, this is my duty, not a hobby.
